subject: Replace retired Skogsstyrelsen proxies with the open GeoTIFF mirror (IM-022)
description: Owner decision 2026-10-12: download the open data we need (the same products the tiles already carry) to the PVC; keep-or-scrap of the raw files decided after enrichment. Scope: stage per-county GeoTIFF zips from geodpags.skogsstyrelsen.se/geodataport/data/ under /data/skg_open with MANIFEST.json (scripts/stage_skg_open.py, k8s/skg-open-stage-job.yaml); a mirror reader imint/training/skg_open.py with the skg_height.py signature and .npy cache contract; skg_grunddata.py and slu_markfukt.py read the mirror; the proxy path (skg_height.py, skg_imageserver.py, .skg_endpoints) is removed, not shimmed; parity against proxy-fetched cache arrays; tests for the adapter, grid snapping, staging plan and manifest. Not in scope: enriching tiles under /data/unified_v2_512* or the staging roots (census session's later pass), GPU jobs, PVC expansion.
